--- pipe_join_tvf.sql
FROM LeftTable
|> JOIN ReadRightTable(1) USING(id)

--- AST
&ast.QueryStatement{
  Query: &ast.Query{
    Query: &ast.FromQuery{
      From: &ast.From{
        Source: &ast.TableName{
          Table: &ast.Ident{
            NamePos: 5,
            NameEnd: 14,
            Name:    "LeftTable",
          },
        },
      },
    },
    PipeOperators: []ast.PipeOperator{
      &ast.PipeJoin{
        Pipe:  15,
        Op:    "INNER JOIN",
        Right: &ast.TVFCallExpr{
          Rparen: 39,
          Name:   &ast.Path{
            Idents: []*ast.Ident{
              &ast.Ident{
                NamePos: 23,
                NameEnd: 37,
                Name:    "ReadRightTable",
              },
            },
          },
          Args: []ast.TVFArg{
            &ast.ExprArg{
              Expr: &ast.IntLiteral{
                ValuePos: 38,
                ValueEnd: 39,
                Base:     10,
                Value:    "1",
              },
            },
          },
        },
        Cond: &ast.Using{
          Using:  41,
          Rparen: 49,
          Idents: []*ast.Ident{
            &ast.Ident{
              NamePos: 47,
              NameEnd: 49,
              Name:    "id",
            },
          },
        },
      },
    },
  },
}

--- SQL
FROM LeftTable |> INNER JOIN ReadRightTable(1) USING (id)
